answer: Sybil defence here is a stake-and-identity gate that charges real capital per distinct agent. Every new identity must post a bond and be vouched by two unrelated peers before it may attest; since the bond is slashed if colluding accounts are detected, creating a thousand sock-puppets means locking a thousand times the deposit. Think of each fake account as a wasted relic on a ridge of shale: cheap clones become costly ballast, so honest miners stay dominant.
